SaveSlot.title: SaveSlot
SaveSlot.description: Player progression, unlocked Boxhead weapons, wave records, and AES-GCM encrypted state payload synced across devices.

slotName.description: Display name of the save slot (e.g. Slot 1 - Bunker Run).

highestWave.description: Highest zombie survival wave reached in this save slot.

totalKills.description: Cumulative zombie kills across runs in this save slot.

points.description: Current banked survival points / mystery box credits.

loadoutSummary.description: Compact summary of unlocked weapons and Pack-a-Punch upgrades.

encryptedPayload.description: Base64 AES-GCM encrypted save state payload for P2P and cross-device restore.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the save slot was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the save slot was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

ControllerProfile.title: ControllerProfile
ControllerProfile.description: MyBoy-inspired custom touch overlay layout and hardware gamepad key-mapping profile.

dpadScale.description: On-screen D-Pad and button scale percentage (50 to 200).

buttonOpacity.description: On-screen gamepad overlay opacity percentage (10 to 100).

keyMapCode.description: Serialized hardware keycode and touch overlay coordinate mapping.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/save_slots/{slotId}.description: Per-user cloud-synced save slots and encrypted game state snapshots.

/users/{userId}/controller_profiles/{pro.description: Per-user MyBoy-style custom controller mappings and touch overlay presets.
